evidence_policy: Do not set done without merged PR/commit and observed acceptance checks.

phases.name: Foundation / audit
phases.goal: Verify the shipped product and establish an honest reproducible baseline.

phases.name: Scene system / art pipeline
phases.goal: Create reusable premium scene grammar, world and character pipeline.

phases.name: Gold Chapter 1
phases.goal: Ship three outstanding playable scenes with true agency and feedback.

phases.name: Gold Chapters 1–3
phases.goal: Prove a sustained first-session experience across nine connected scenes.

phases.name: Persistent simulation foundation
phases.goal: Harden state, actor, evidence and consequence systems before content scale.

phases.name: Polished Act I
phases.goal: Upgrade all 18 Act I scenes, routes and ending quality.

phases.name: Act II — The Operator
phases.goal: Turn political plans and institutions into execution mechanics.

phases.name: Act III — The Kingmaker
phases.goal: Make agenda, coalitions, appointments and networks player agency.

phases.name: Act IV — The Counterplayer
phases.goal: Deliver fair adversarial intelligence and player-model counterplay.

phases.name: Act V — The System
phases.goal: Ship playable interacting national crises and triage.

phases.name: Act VI — Legacy
phases.goal: Resolve succession, constitutional design and accumulated historical consequence.

phases.name: Curriculum / balance / modes
phases.goal: Embed strategic mastery, calibration, fair challenge and adaptive difficulty.

phases.name: Art / sound / game feel / accessibility
phases.goal: Give Lydria consistent visual/audio identity and accessible cinematic experience.

phases.name: Quality / delivery / release
phases.goal: Make the full product reliable, observable and ready for release.

tasks.title: Audit canonical entrypoints and stale references
deliverables: Versioned inventory of shipped vs obsolete files and doc corrections
acceptance_criteria: Live index/import graph and all 18 scene IDs recorded
Obsolete design claims identified without changing canon
tasks.notes: Audited main and corrected stale planning hypothesis. PR #4 includes inventory, import map and 18 IDs. Acceptance by repository inspection and CI backlog integrity; no browser or user playtest implied.

tasks.title: Create repeatable local build/test workflow
deliverables: package scripts or equivalent reproducible commands
acceptance_criteria: Fresh checkout boots app and reports errors consistently
Instructions work without special private development setup
tasks.notes: Node no-dependency preview+CLI, static import check and HTTP server smoke; no browser/device acceptance.

tasks.title: Add no-dependency smoke tests for imported scene data
deliverables: Automated data/import smoke and scene-count tests
acceptance_criteria: All 18 Act I scene definitions resolve and have unique IDs
Broken imports or malformed choices fail CI/local command
tasks.notes: 18 scenes, choices, imports and presentation mapping tested. Fixed malformed C02_S03 Civic Compact choice, initially detected by CI.

tasks.title: Add deterministic decision/save/restore fixtures
deliverables: Golden smoke fixtures for first scene, mid run and ending
acceptance_criteria: Choices mutate, save and reload as expected
No hidden score shown prior to commitment
tasks.notes: Deterministic first choice/save, 3 opening branches, 18-scene progression, callbacks, legacy v02, reset and corrupt-storage tests. No exhaustive routes/browser QA.

tasks.title: Baseline visual snapshots at phone and desktop widths
deliverables: Screenshots, clipping ledger, target viewport matrix
acceptance_criteria: First/longest/final scenes have captured layouts
All clipped actions, illegible facts and overlap have issues
tasks.notes: Issue #12 320px overlap/long-choice fix on task branch (e5474e6): GitHub Actions check PASS, 16/16 Node tests PASS, backlog validator PASS, Chromium 15 screenshots/0 geometry warnings/0 page errors, 4-width mobile layout regression PASS and browser interaction smoke PASS. Assistant reviewed 320/375 screenshots; owner visual approval, real iOS Safari/system text-size/touch and PR/merge remain pending. KM-005 stays review.

tasks.title: Audit existing v0.3 state against v1 schema
deliverables: Gap and migration map for schema/spec/runtime
acceptance_criteria: Every key system marked shipped/partial/spec only
Backward-compatible migration risks and test fixtures identified
tasks.notes: Schema audit documentation and 14-field/8-domain machine coverage map, with 2 regression tests; no runtime save migration was implemented.

tasks.title: Record baseline UX playtest and risk register
deliverables: Short moderated test protocol, findings and ranked risks
acceptance_criteria: At least three novice sessions or clearly flagged unavailable
Comprehension/engagement blockers separated from aesthetic opinions

tasks.title: CI, branch protections and issue delivery convention
deliverables: Automated checks, PR template, ownership and change discipline
acceptance_criteria: Pull requests run import, backlog-validation and baseline tests
Human approval rules and merge/rollback ownership documented
tasks.notes: All PRs run game-tests and validate-backlog. CODEOWNERS and rollback conventions delivered; actual main ruleset requires owner action (issue #10) and must be verified before done.

tasks.title: Define versioned scene presentation contract
deliverables: Scene mode schema with actors, source IDs, pressure and art refs
acceptance_criteria: 18 current scenes can resolve through contract and fallbacks
Unknown mode/actor fails gracefully and validates
tasks.notes: v1 adapter resolves all 18 scenes, unknown modes/actors fail softly, source and art refs remain explicit; runtime visual metadata wired; Node regression tests passed. Browser/device visual acceptance remains downstream.

tasks.title: Implement adaptive scene layout shell
deliverables: Responsive world/context/decision composition
acceptance_criteria: No clipped primary action at small/large viewport and enlarged text
Touch and keyboard navigation remain usable

tasks.title: Separate scene renderer from interaction/state orchestration
deliverables: Modular renderer and controller boundary
acceptance_criteria: Existing commit/save/back/instruments flows survive refactor
View is not allowed to mutate simulation silently
tasks.notes: Pure scene/context/consequence/finale renderer extracted; Node tests show no state mutation; real Chromium click/commit/instruments/save/reload/reset smoke passed at 390x844 and five-viewport baseline 15/15; utility-only templates remain for separate cleanup, no save schema changes.
